description: The ht-cli command-line client for HostTracker: run instant website checks, manage monitors, contacts, webhooks and status pages from a terminal or a CI pipeline.
rules: Install with brew install HostTracker/tap/ht-cli, go install github.com/HostTracker/cli/cmd/ht-cli@latest, or the packages in the GitHub releases.
Authenticate once with ht-cli auth login (token minted at https://www.host-tracker.com/integrations/api) or set HT_TOKEN.
Every API operation is a command grouped by family, for example ht-cli monitors list, ht-cli check run <url> --wait; add --output json for machine-readable output.
